{{Quote|Turns out that Captain Garrud wasn't working alone. My people have identified a Bothan informant named Fadulk Di'keer that's been playing both sides of the fence. This guy's worked as an assistant to quite a few Corellian bigwigs, including the late Diktat himself. Turns out the Imperials have also identified him so he's on the lam. Find him before the Imperials do and bring him back here. Understand that we need him very much alive if we're to discover what kind of information he's sold to the Empire concerning our activities. Can you do it?|Garm Bel Iblis|<ref name="AED" />}}
'''Fadulk Di'keer''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] [[Information broker/Legends|information broker]] who lived during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="AED" />

==Behind the scenes==
Fadulk Di'keer was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Roleplaying game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]], prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="AED" /><ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref>

Because Fadulk Di'keer spawned under the generic "bothan_information_broker" template, his appearance was randomized under one of two possible depictions. He could either appear as a male Bothan or a female Bothan. Because the [[W:c:swg:Quest|quest]] dialogue identified Di'keer as male, this article assumes that the male Bothan depiction is [[canon]] in the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity.<ref name="AED" />
